purpose: Define the verified native hero level + grade layer while keeping final displayed Attributes separated from skills, exclusive weapon, awakening/promotion, gear and account-wide effects.

nativeDataDiscovery.note: The embedded DataTable version and the public hot-update descriptor are separate version layers. Do not equate 38781 with hot-update descriptor 1295.

hardRules: Do not use displayed account ATK/DEF/HP as native hero inputs because they can already include account-wide buffs.
Use each hero's native template_id from lw_hero; never substitute template 1 for template 2 or vice versa.
Never treat an SSR-to-UR promotion as a cosmetic rarity change. SSR and UR states are distinct combat/stat variants.
Do not derive total hero power from the native level+grade layer alone. Final Attributes also depend on skills, exclusive weapon, awakening/promotion, gear and other modeled layers.
Unknown coefficients remain pending; no silent fallback from one rarity, template or variant to another.
Join native hero configuration by numeric nativeId, never by localized display name.
HQ35 hero level cap is 175. The 174 rows in lw_hero_level represent transitions ending at level 174 and therefore lead to terminal level 175.

nativeLevelModel.rounding: floor each native level component after hero-base scaling

starGradeModel.rounding: floor each Grade component after hero-base scaling

knownAnchor.warning: Do not simplify this to a generic 28% Grade rule. The verified model uses the exact attr_add values stored for each rank.

requiredNext: Verify the exact user-facing star/sub-rank mapping for ranks 1 through 26 before converting a decimal stars field directly to native rank.
Keep star-unlocked skill effects separate from the Grade stat layer.

verifiedNativeLayer.definition: native level contribution + native Grade contribution only
verifiedNativeLayer.warning: These are not final displayed in-game Attributes. Do not overwrite displayed ATK/DEF/HP until remaining layers are modeled and validated.

rules: Track star breakpoints separately from medal-level scaling.
Expertise/Super Sensing stat percentages are a skill layer and must not be baked into native level stats.
Promoted SSR-to-UR heroes may receive a different skill kit and reset skill levels.

violet-ssr and violet-ur are distinct variants
scarlett-ssr and scarlett-ur are distinct variants
sarah-ssr and sarah-ur are distinct variants
venom-ssr and venom-ur are distinct variants

promotionCommonObservedRules.postPromotionStarShardCost: UR-cost / approximately double SSR promotion path
promotionCommonObservedRules.warning: Historical early Mason promotions briefly reset to 0 stars before the mechanic was changed; simulator models the current 3-star rule unless a historical-season mode is explicitly requested.
